english.note: Use this only for the emphatic sense meaning that the person or group did something personally, not for an object reflexive.

exampleSentences.english: The board members themselves came down to help.
exampleSentences.jyutping: baan1 dung2 si6 can1 zi6 lok6 coeng4 bong1 sau2

english.note: Use this when the emphasis is that he personally carried out the action rather than someone else.

exampleSentences.english: The boss handled this complaint himself.
exampleSentences.traditional: 老闆親自處理呢單投訴。
exampleSentences.jyutping: lou5 baan2 can1 zi6 cyu2 lei5 ni1 daan1 tau4 sou3

english.note: Use this for emphatic myself when the emphasis is on personally carrying out or witnessing the action.

exampleSentences.english: I went to the counter myself to pick up the order.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 can1 zi6 heoi3 gwai6 wai2 ling1 fo3

english.note: Use this with 我哋 as the subject when stressing that the group personally carried out the action rather than someone else.

exampleSentences.english: We will handle the event ourselves this time.
exampleSentences.traditional: 今次個活動我哋親自搞掂。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 wut6 dung6 ngo5 dei6 can1 zi6 gaau2 dim6
